facts.text: Maria expressed admiration for John's commitment to his beliefs.

evidence.quote: Wow, John! It's great to see you standing up for your beliefs.

facts.text: John acknowledged Maria's appreciation and mentioned the importance of shared values and passion in motivating him.

evidence.quote: Thanks Maria, it was amazing being around others who shared the same values and passion as me. It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism. It really motivated me.

facts.text: Maria encouraged John to continue his efforts and emphasized the importance of striving for progress.

evidence.quote: Let's keep up the good work and make a difference.
